high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from "The New Indian Express," a news website. The top of the screen shows the website's logo and navigation tabs such as "NATION," "WORLD," "STATES," "OPINIONS," and a menu icon on the left. There is also a battery indicator showing low power. The main content of the article discusses two individuals who had a passion for forests and wildlife but lacked field experience or scientific training. They both courted controversies with enthusiasm and dedicated their lives to wildlife conservation.
